## Summary

Describe the outcome and the security boundary affected.

## Validation

- [ ] Tests cover allowed and denied behavior.
- [ ] `bash scripts/security_check.sh` passes, or failures are documented.
- [ ] Migrations were reviewed and checked.
- [ ] Documentation matches implemented behavior.
- [ ] No secrets, runtime data, private reports, or internal identifiers are included.
- [ ] No license or unverified floating workflow action was added.

## Security review

List authorization, evidence-lifecycle, connector, upload, settings, and migration implications.
For a vulnerability, stop and use the private process in `SECURITY.md` instead of this template.
